description: Residential redevelopment of 24-38 Green Lane, Northwood, London. BIM Earth Consultancy delivered Architecture, Structure and MEP services across the Conceptual, Design, Construction and As-Built stages, developing an existing site model, two design options and the final proposal in BIM, along with as-built models and drawings.
scope: Design Option 01 and Design Option 02 models
Final proposal design model and visualisation
Architecture, Structure and MEP redevelopment modelling
Conceptual, Design and Construction stage drawings
highlight: Existing site model, two design options and a final proposal developed in BIM to support design decisions.
